who-whopir-492199ae88d3.summary: WHO가 인도 쿠르쿰브의 Cipla Limited 완제의약품 제조소를 실사하고 WHO GMP 지침 준수 수준이 수용 가능하다고 판단했다.
key_facts: 결론: WHO GMP 지침 준수 수준 수용 가능, 3년 유효(기간 중 실사 결과가 긍정적일 때)
who-whopir-492199ae88d3.implication: 실사에서 확인된 미준수 사항은 WHOPIR 공개 전에 모두 만족스럽게 해결됐다. 공정 재밸리데이션은 3년마다 1배치, 세척 확인은 매년 1배치였다. 시험법 재밸리데이션은 7년마다, 설비·유틸리티 재적격성평가는 5년마다였다.

en.hook_line: All inspection non-compliances addressed before publication, valid for 3 years
en.summary: WHO inspected the Cipla Limited finished pharmaceutical product site at Kurkumbh, India, and considered it to be operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP guidelines.
key_facts: Conclusion: acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP guidelines, valid for 3 years provided later inspections are positive
en.implication: All non-compliances observed during the inspection were addressed to a satisfactory level before the WHOPIR was published. One batch every 3 years was revalidated for the manufacturing process and one batch every year for cleaning verification. Analytical revalidation was every 7 years and equipment and utilities requalification every 5 years.

who-whopir-98cfb8b39789.title_issue: 서면 평가로 WHO GMP 수용 판정

who-whopir-98cfb8b39789.summary: WHO가 인도 앙클레슈와르의 Lupin Limited 에탐부톨 원료의약품 공장을 현장 실사 대신 서면 평가하고 원료의약품 WHO GMP 지침 준수 수준이 수용 가능하다고 판단했다.
key_facts: 결론: 서면 평가로 원료의약품 WHO GMP 지침 준수 수준 수용 가능, 3년 유효(기간 중 실사 결과가 긍정적일 때)
who-whopir-98cfb8b39789.implication: WHO는 이전 WHO 실사와 제출된 GMP 근거 자료를 검토했다. 근거로 삼은 실사는 미국 FDA(2026-03-02~07, 2022-08-16~19)와 호주 TGA(2024-10-03~04)다.

en.title_issue: WHO GMP accepted via desk assessment

key_facts: Conclusion: acceptable compliance with WHO GMP guidelines for APIs by desk assessment, valid for 3 years provided later inspections are positive
en.implication: WHO reviewed previous WHO inspections and the GMP evidence received. The inspections relied on were by the US FDA (2026-03-02 to 07 and 2022-08-16 to 19) and TGA Australia (2024-10-03 to 04).

who-whopir-d6ea75f7687f.title_issue: WHO GMP 준수 수준 수용 판정
who-whopir-d6ea75f7687f.hook_line: 두 공용 제조 구역 실사 미준수 사항을 공개 전에 해결, 3년 유효
who-whopir-d6ea75f7687f.summary: WHO가 인도 히마찰프라데시의 Oxalis Labs 완제의약품 제조소를 실사하고 WHO GMP 지침 준수 수준이 수용 가능하다고 판단했다.

en.hook_line: Inspection non-compliances addressed before publication, valid for 3 years
en.summary: WHO inspected the Oxalis Labs finished pharmaceutical product site in Himachal Pradesh, India, and considered it to be operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP guidelines.
key_facts: Conclusion: acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP guidelines, valid for 3 years provided later inspections are positive
en.implication: All non-compliances observed during the inspection were addressed to a satisfactory level before the WHOPIR was published. Oxalis Labs manufactures finished pharmaceutical products for Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited. WHO-prequalified and under-assessment products were made in two shared areas, the general tablet block and the Rifa block.
